definitions.explanation: one's personal environment; things around oneself

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{回|まわ}りを{整理|せいり}する。
{身|み}の{回|まわ}りで{起|お}きたことを{話|はな}す。
examples.english: Talk about what happened in one's surroundings.

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{回|まわ}りに{危険|きけん}がないか{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked whether there was any danger in my surroundings.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}には{身|み}の{回|まわ}りの{品|しな}だけ{持|も}っていく。
examples.english: I only bring personal necessities when traveling.

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{回|まわ}りの{世話|せわ}をする。
examples.english: To take care of someone's personal needs.

examples.japanese: {入院|にゅういん}に{備|そな}えて{身|み}の{回|まわ}り{品|ひん}を{準備|じゅんび}した。
examples.english: I prepared my personal items in preparation for hospitalization.

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{回|まわ}りのことは{自分|じぶん}でできます。
examples.english: I can take care of my own personal needs.

notes:
{身|み}の{回|まわ}り refers to both one's immediate environment and personal belongings.

SENSE 1 - SURROUNDINGS:
- The immediate environment around a person
- Events or situations in one's personal sphere

SENSE 2 - PERSONAL EFFECTS:
- Daily necessities and personal belongings
- Items one needs for daily life (toiletries, clothes, etc.)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身|み}の{回|まわ}りの{品|しな}/{身|み}の{回|まわ}り{品|ひん} (personal effects)
- {身|み}の{回|まわ}りを{整|ととの}える (to arrange one's personal affairs)
- {身|み}の{回|まわ}りの{世話|せわ} (personal care)
- {身|み}の{回|まわ}りのこと (personal matters/needs)

USAGE:
- Hospital stays: {入院|にゅういん}セット with {身|み}の{回|まわ}り{品|ひん}
- Caregiving: Taking care of someone's {身|み}の{回|まわ}り
- Travel: Packing only {身|み}の{回|まわ}り{品|ひん}

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {周囲|しゅうい}: Surroundings (more general)
- {私物|しぶつ}: Personal belongings (more formal)

REGISTER: Neutral.
